title: fn-octets$c-get-word reads K=4 and K=8 octets through the recursive fn-oct-word-down (only K=7 has the unrolled word7 path): the in-place page fill (fn-pgb-frame-put, two 4-octet reads per word) costs 146 us a page against 97 us for the list version it replaced, with 0 bytes consed against 155,599. An unrolled k=4 (and k=8 on an unboxed return) exec path in the foundation, with the same abstract reader, closes the gap
